TEST SCENARIO: Verify Client-Facing Display functionality for the new UI home page sections
TEST CASE: The new UI home page lists every category the client is served, in order, each with icon, name and More Games
PRE-CONDITION: The client platform's new UI (https://test-v2.138hk.vip) is up and its category feed serves at least one Active category with games. Not signed in.
TEST STEPS: 1. Open the home page as a visitor and choose New UI when asked.\n2. Read the client's category feed (/api/member/game-category-features).\n3. Compare the sections drawn on the home page with the feed.
EXPECTED RESULTS: One section per served category, in the feed's order; each headed with the served icon (loaded) and name, and offering More Games.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify Client-Facing Display functionality for the game cards in a section
TEST CASE: Every card in a section draws the banner served for that game's assignment, one card per served game
PRE-CONDITION: As OC-CLI-011.
TEST STEPS: 1. Open the home page as a visitor in the New UI.\n2. For each section, list the cards drawn and the games the feed serves for that category.
EXPECTED RESULTS: Each section has exactly one card per served game, in order; each card's image is the banner uploaded for that assignment (the catalogue image when there is none), loaded, and 160px wide on a PC.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify Client-Facing Display functionality for a section's scroll arrows
TEST CASE: A row with more cards than fit scrolls by its arrows until the last card is in view; a row that fits has none
PRE-CONDITION: As OC-CLI-011, with one category holding more games than fit in one row at 1920px (ten or more).
TEST STEPS:
1. Open the home page as a visitor in the New UI.
2. Note which sections overflow their panel.
3. Press the right arrow of an overflowing section until its last card is on screen.
4. Press its left arrow.
EXPECTED RESULTS: Sections that fit show no arrows. An overflowing section shows a right arrow; pressing it brings the hidden cards into view until the last card is on screen; a left arrow is then offered.
